findings.passage: “Senate Joint Resolution 2 being on the floor today is tone-deaf. It’s a disgrace,” Sen. LaTonya Johnson said. “You should be ashamed. We owe those families apologies.”
findings.note: Quoted by TMJ4 from the Senate session on the voter photo ID constitutional amendment (SJR 2); she ties her objection to a recent school shooting and to timing and priorities.

findings.passage: “I’m irritated,” Democratic Sen. LaTonya Johnson said at the hearing Tuesday, held less than 24 hours after lawmakers were sworn into office. “There are definitely more important issues than this.”
findings.note: Quoted by Wisconsin Watch (story published with the AP) at the committee hearing on the voter ID constitutional amendment; she says other issues matter more.
